snippet.title: Core Valley Promotional Trailer v1
snippet.description:
Welcome to Core Valley; a little homestead, a deeper adventure.

Take a first look at life in the valley through actual gameplay: create your character, build and furnish a home, plant and harvest crops, and cast a line by the water. Then saddle up, cross the desert, sail the ocean, and face the enemies waiting inside the dungeons.

Whether you enjoy a quiet day on the farm or exploring somewhere new, there’s more waiting beyond your doorstep.

Coming to Steam for Windows. Play solo or with family and friends through private LAN co-op.

Subscribe for more gameplay, development updates, and release news.

#CoreValley #IndieGame #CozyGaming
